answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one orchard weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 179 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 128 times the capital for one share. The quartz report makes public the merge explicitly at each quill. A farm of 4266 identities would post 835 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
